weeks.theme: Build the base — RPE 7-8, comp lifts + one variation per day.

exercises.name: Competition Squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard, maintain a neutral spine. Drive knees out and push the floor away.

exercises.name: Pause Squat
exercises.notes: Maintain tension during the 2-second pause at the bottom. Explode up.

exercises.name: Competition Bench
exercises.notes: Elbows slightly tucked, drive feet into the floor. Control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench
exercises.notes: Grip slightly inside shoulder-width. Focus on triceps drive.

exercises.name: Competition Deadlift
exercises.notes: Set up tight, pull slack out of the bar. Drive through the floor.

exercises.name: RDL
exercises.notes: Keep the bar close, feel the stretch in the hamstrings. Hips back, slight knee bend.

exercises.name: Competition Bench
exercises.notes: Maintain arch and leg drive. Control the bar path.

exercises.name: Tempo Bench
exercises.notes: 3-second eccentric, 1-second pause at the bottom. Focus on control.
